messages:
customer-jane: Hey team — our org topbar shows "Wallet: $150 (OnboardingBonus applied)" but API usage and metering report 0 credits consumed, and our invoices still show charges. Org: org_8XX. Can you check?

julie_support: Sorry about that, will investigate. Can you share org id + service key? Is this only visible in topbar or in billing page too? :thinking:

customer-jane: OrgID org_8XX, service key sk-xyz123 (redacted). Topbar + header banner show promo applied. We ran requests with sk-xyz123 earlier today; example curl below — tokens consumed but invoice unchanged.

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xyz123' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

matt_billing: @julie_support pinging billing. I can see a promo grant named "OnboardingBonus" attached to org_8XX. Ledger has no entries applying it to proj_77. Are org grants supposed to auto-allocate to projects? I'll check grant flags.

kevin_infra: @matt_billing I'll tail metering for sk-xyz123 now. Any sample request time + x-request-id?

customer-jane: Sample request timestamp ~2333332988, header `x-request-id: rq_44b`, `x-metering-tokens: 12`. Screenshot of topbar uploaded to ticket.

billing-bot: [automation] Created internal ticket TKT-8452 linking org_8XX wallet to billing ledger for investigation.

matt_billing: Quick note: some grants are org-scoped and need allocation to projects (apply_at_project=false). If the allocation job failed, UI will still show wallet but consumption won't be offset. @julie_support was this grant created via the console or imported?

julie_support: Created via console promo flow on 2333000000 by CSM. I'll fetch grant record and allocation logs.

kevin_infra: Found metering events for rq_44b at ingest offset 572: tokens=12, project=proj_77, service_key=sk-xyz123. Events reached billing queue at 2333333005. No allocation entry present. Allocation worker shows OOM at 2333000012.

matt_billing: Proposed interim action: create manual ledger refund applying OnboardingBonus to proj_77 to offset charges while we fix provisioning. ok with you @customer-jane?

customer-jane: Yes please — that would avoid impact to our billing cycle.

julie_support: Creating manual ledger adjustment now and will follow-up with automation fix and steps to avoid recurrence. :thumbsup:

kevin_infra: Root cause hypothesis: allocation worker crashed during provisioning window (OOM on worker-alloc-3). Will replay allocation job and add retries + idempotency.

matt_billing: Logged manual refund TKT-8452-REFUND for $150 credited to proj_77. Expect invoice to update within a few minutes.

customer-jane: Refund is now visible in billing UI, invoice updated. Thanks all!

julie_support: Marking the thread resolved, creating a short postmortem for alloc-worker crash and adding alerting around alloc job failures. We'll notify once the patch is deployed.

kevin_infra: Patch with retry + OOM mitigation merged. Deploy scheduled tonight.

customer-jane: Appreciate the fast turnaround, thanks :)
